text: Assumption: The registration of the notifiers preferably takes place bundled in the initialization phase of the application — is this correct?

assumption: The registration of the notifiers preferably takes place bundled in the initialization phase of the application.
rationale: The specification [SWS_DM_00667] and [SWS_DM_00673] specifies that consecutive registrations overwrite earlier callbacks and the methods are not thread-safe, but does not provide an explicit phase recommendation.
